name: relay-panel
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /relay, plus an agents panel (/relay-agents) with swappable sprite packs: running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time. Forked from savvy-progress in johnnyvizz/claude-kit.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: relay: when a relay worker starts or a plan is reported; any: also when any other subagent starts

pack.title: Everyday pack
pack.description: The pack drawn all year, or shuffle for a random non-holiday pack each session. /relay-pack <id> or /relay-pack shuffle overrides it

seasons.title: Holiday packs
seasons.description: on: turkeys Nov 15-30 and Christmas in December replace the everyday pack; off: the everyday pack all year. /relay-pack seasons on|off overrides it
